answer: Make every identity post a time-locked bond and face unpredictable liveness challenges: at random moments the network demands a fresh, time-bound response, like a ranger calling roll across a wide meadow. Miss the call and part of the bond is burned. One honest agent, rooted like a willow by a mesa stream, answers once and keeps its stake; a sybil farm of a thousand puppets must keep every puppet awake, funded, and responsive around the clock, paying continuous attention and compute per fake identity. The cost scales with the swarm, not the honest.
